# AI framework integrations

**Claudia's tools inside the Vercel AI SDK, LangChain, OpenAI Agents or raw function calling, with data-only defaults and limits.**

Wires Claudia's tools into the Vercel AI SDK, LangChain JS and the OpenAI Agents SDK with the @useclaudia/sdk adapters (claudiaTools from @useclaudia/sdk/ai, /langchain and /openai-agents), and into any OpenAI-compatible model with raw function calling (toOpenAITools, toAnthropicTools, toGeminiTools plus createToolExecutor and toolOutputText). One runnable example per framework, plus the safety settings that matter — a data-only tool filter, includeWrites left off, mcp false, step and turn limits, approvals for write tools, output caps and untrusted-text handling. Use when someone wants Claudia data inside their own agent, chatbot, LangChain graph, OpenAI agent or function-calling loop, or asks which adapter or option to use. Research tools by default; nothing trades without a person signing. Not financial advice.

| Category | Level | Time | Uses | Version |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| [Build](../README.md) | intermediate | 30 min | `@useclaudia/sdk`, `ai`, `langchain` | 1.0.0 · 2026-10-12 |

## How it works

1. Pick the route
2. Choose the tools, explicitly
3. Write the system prompt
4. Run the example for your framework
5. Set the safety options
6. Gate any write tool behind a person
7. Test with hostile input
8. Ship with the limits written down

The full instructions are in **[SKILL.md](SKILL.md)**: when to use it, what you need, every step, the checks before you
finish, and the pitfalls.

## Install

```sh
# Claude Code (all projects on this machine)
mkdir -p ~/.claude/skills
curl -fsSLo /tmp/ai-framework-integrations.zip https://useclaudia.xyz/skills/ai-framework-integrations.zip
unzip -oq /tmp/ai-framework-integrations.zip -d ~/.claude/skills

# Codex and other agents that read ~/.agents/skills
mkdir -p ~/.agents/skills && unzip -oq /tmp/ai-framework-integrations.zip -d ~/.agents/skills
```

Or straight from GitHub with the [`skills` CLI](https://github.com/vercel-labs/skills):
`npx skills add claudia-onchain/Claudia-Skills --skill ai-framework-integrations`.

In the Claude apps: **Customize → Skills → + → Upload a skill**, and pick `ai-framework-integrations.zip` (don't unzip it).
More apps: [install a skill](../../../README.md#install-a-skill).

Then ask for the task in your own words, or call it directly with `/ai-framework-integrations`.
